reason: Authors train 2-layer CNNs and a PCBM with a ResNet-18 backbone plus a scikit-learn SGD concept classifier; DINO/CLIP are only used pretrained as models being compared.
Experiments train a small CNN and ResNet-20, DINOv2 ViT and BERT classifiers, ridge regression and deep/tabular MLPs.
PULSE and the CL/SVAE comparisons use the same dilated convolution encoder; no other model family is named for the method.
The spectral policy network uses a 1D convolutional stem with residual blocks, and the student is a video rPPG network trained by the authors.
Ridge-regression encoding models are fit on features extracted from 350+ pretrained image, video (convolutional and transformer) and language models.
MultiFloor3D is training-free and relies on unnamed reconstruction and segmentation models; the LLM appears only in an application demo.
The benchmark trains YOLO-series and DETR-based detectors, and the proposed TDnet baseline uses a YOLO-style detection head.
Distilled data are used to train SRCNN and REDCNN networks for super-resolution and restoration.
The pipeline exploits D-SCRIPT/Topsy-Turvy embeddings (BiLSTM encoder plus convolutional contact module) and fine-tunes a PubMedBERT cross-encoder with BERT-size bi-encoders for re-ranking.
The benchmark runs structure-based diffusion/flow generators (RFdiffusion, FrameFlow, Genie2) and sequence-based models ESM3 and DPLM.
TPFM-DIR is implemented as a time-embedded UNet with gated-attention skip connections; other backbones are not named.
kCGM finetunes the autoregressive G2PT transformer, the Genie 2 diffusion model and a convolutional masked discrete diffusion model trained by the authors.
TACO RL-finetunes a pretrained autoregressive DNA model and uses a LightGBM fitness model; DDSM diffusion is only a compared baseline.
MID embeds image-mask pairs with a frozen MedSigLIP vision-language encoder and fits Gaussians/PCA on the features.
UniSite uses a DETR-style transformer encoder-decoder and, for UniSite-3D, a GearNet-Edge GNN structural encoder trained from scratch.
Pretrained VLMs are the only model family named; the RL agents (DreamerV3, TD-MPC2) are listed without architecture descriptions.
Clients train small convolutional networks and FedDAG learns its view weights with a lightweight MLP.
AtlasSegFM adapts the RDP registration network, nnInteractive/vesselFM and a lightweight 3D encoder, but no model family is named.
FedWMSAM is evaluated with an MLP on Fashion-MNIST and ResNet-18/34/50 backbones on the other datasets.
The ETAP predictors are spline plus ridge regression models, and the MTL models trained are ResNet-18, Autoformer and feed-forward networks.
